metadata.description: Web search, clean page reading and passage ranking for AI agents, on its own or together with Tavily.

plugins.name: searchify
plugins.description: Searchify on its own: keyless web search, clean page reading and passage ranking on your machine. No API key.

plugins.name: searchify-tavily
plugins.description: Searchify for Tavily: Tavily searches and extracts with your key, Searchify ranks the passages on your machine and takes over any call where Tavily is slow.
